title: Where the framework can register a test once the engine has selected the variants, each variant is a test of its own: a failing variant fails only its own test, and the withheld contract fails the suite.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': the closure runs once per selected variant, and a failed variant fails that variant only. 'finalise': when the result carries no contract, it fails, naming every interaction and variant whose status is not 'verified'. The style guides, 'Test-framework integration': each variant is a test named 'label [id]', or 'base' for the base variant — under JUnit 5, janus.variants returned from a @TestFactory; under Spock, a feature whose where: block is janus.variants, each row run with janus.run; under Vitest and Jest as ES modules, await janus.variants at the top level of the test file (staged plan S3.5).
note: Jest from CommonJS cannot register a test after an await, so it has 'execute' alone, which runs every variant within one test under every framework (framework/withheld-contract-fails-the-suite).
